history: Founded on a bold vision of contemporary hospitality, Cen21 Hospitality brings together iconic addresses where gastronomy, mixology, and scenography meet. Each venue cultivates its own identity while sharing a common standard: delivering memorable moments.
vision: To become the African benchmark for premium lifestyle experiences, creating worlds where detail, service, and emotion redefine industry standards.

values.title: Excellence
values.description: An uncompromising standard in every detail, from service to atmosphere.

values.title: Creativity
values.description: Living concepts in constant evolution, driven by passionate talent.

values.title: Authenticity
values.description: Places with soul, rooted in their territory and community.

values.title: Discretion
values.description: Contemporary luxury that is elegant and understated.

positioning: Cen21 Hospitality embodies modern luxury: editorial minimalism, cinematic depth, and exceptional nightlife experiences inspired by palace hotels and the international lifestyle scene.

team.name: Kenny Rawtani
team.quote: Building tomorrow's African luxury means honoring the richness of our land.
team.bio: Visionary entrepreneur, Kenny Rawtani founded Cen21 Hospitality with the conviction that Africa deserves its own benchmarks for premium lifestyle experiences. His leadership embodies the ambition of a group in constant motion.

team.name: Ritesh Hemnani
team.quote: Excellence is not a goal — it's a habit cultivated every single day.
team.bio: With deep expertise in strategic development, Ritesh Hemnani oversees the group's growth and partnerships, ensuring seamless coherence between vision and execution at every step of Cen21's expansion.

team.name: Subrajeet Phookan
team.quote: Every detail matters. It's the sum of small things that creates the extraordinary.
team.bio: As Chief Executive Officer, Subrajeet Phookan orchestrates our venues' daily operations with operational rigor and a passion for hospitality that defines the Cen21 identity. He embodies the standards of a group built for the future.
